personality_one_liner: A deeply traditional, devotional reading experience evoking ancient parchment, gold ornaments, and sacred maroon tones.

spacing.rule: Generous editorial spacing, allowing ornamental borders to breathe.

dont's: Avoid all SaaS gradients and glassmorphism as per user request.

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: Dashboard with daily shloka, continue reading, popular books, and mantras.
screens.layout: Devotional header illustration with maroon ribbon title banner. Rounded cream cards (surfaceSecondary) with subtle gold shadow. Golden lotus separators between sections.

screens.name: Books Library
screens.purpose: Browse library with search, category chips, and a 3-column cover grid.
screens.layout: Sticky search and scrollable category chips below the header. 3-column grid for covers with ornamental gold borders.

screens.name: Reader
screens.purpose: Traditional parchment e-book reader with verse numbering and embedded audio player.
screens.layout: Parchment Cream background. Serif text layout with traditional margins. Highlight currently playing verse in Premium Gold. Audio player card floats at bottom.

screens.name: Bookmarks
screens.purpose: Manage bookmarks, verses, chapters, and notes.
screens.layout: Filter chips at top. Cards with cover thumbnail and collection tags in Deep Maroon.

screens.name: Settings & Drawer
screens.purpose: App settings, language selection, activity stats, and Dana donation.
screens.layout: Hamburger drawer with dark burgundy background and gold text. Settings list rows inside cream cards.

devotional_header.alt: Hindu temple architecture for devotional header

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly use the defined color palette: Deep Maroon, Dark Burgundy, Antique Gold, Premium Gold, Parchment Cream, Ivory, Traditional Brown.
No glassmorphism, no SaaS gradients. Use solid cream cards with subtle gold borders/shadows.
Implement the bottom tab bar with a Deep Maroon background and a gold-bordered highlighted active tab (golden-brown gradient pill with gold text).
Use 'Crimson Text' for English UI, and ensure proper fallback for Noto Serif Devanagari / Telugu as required by the user.
Add golden lotus separators between major home sections and ornamental gold borders around book covers.
Ensure Reader mode uses a parchment style layout with Premium Gold highlights for the active playing audio verse.
